page.notes: Uncertain readings: "sic si aeterum" (the word after "si" is faint; "1" may be a ligature), "fortum" (could be read differently), "prudes" (a mark may be a contraction), and the catchword "ioꝛ&". "Fernelianaiudicabis" appears to lack a space between "Ferneliana" and "iudicabis" in the print. "ceteres" is printed "aeteres" and "ceteri" is printed with a slightly blurred letter; both are transcribed with the likely reading. The hyphen after "ha" and "ef" is taken from the line ends. Printed "viam" is split as "vi-am" across lines.
